capture.reason: Stopped at preconditions: no approved trace-to-local-file export path was available, and the visible session was not verified as the synthetic account.

blockers.detail: The available browser integration documents raw CDP access but exposes no approved direct trace-to-local-file export method. The prior browser URL policy evidence explicitly bars retrying the rejected transfer through raw CDP, another browser surface, or a workaround.
A Dashboard accessibility state was visible, but no account identity was inspected and synthetic-account status was not established.

limitations: No trace, fixed-field observer output, checkpoint, input timing, request/RSC timing, or main-thread measurement was captured in this phase.
Dashboard visibility does not establish a stable ready baseline or synthetic-account identity.
This is a browser-capability/precondition blocker, not evidence about application performance, functionality, the wait boundary, or a backend/database cause.
Hosted release identity matches the previously observed release; local HEAD is not the deployed source.
nextGate: Resume Phase 3 only when a platform-approved trace-to-local-file export path is available and the signed-in account is verified as synthetic; do not use raw CDP or alternate surfaces to reproduce the blocked transfer.
